idea-plugin.name: Core Commit AI
idea-plugin.description:
TYPO3 commit messages for PhpStorm

Generates TYPO3-style commit messages with a local Ollama model, OpenAI (or any OpenAI-compatible server) or Claude.
Sends a real unified diff of exactly the files checked in the commit dialog, formats [!!!][KEYWORD] Subject, 72-column * bullets and optional Resolves: / Releases: footer lines. With Ollama nothing leaves the machine except the request to your Ollama URL; with OpenAI or Claude the diff is sent to that provider.

Built with AI assistance (Claude by Anthropic). Designed and maintained by sivaprasad1988.
